blocks.html: Whether you’re stocking up on essentials, ordering meals from different restaurants, or in need of a new outfit, Robinsons Malls continues to give customers a convenient way to shop through MallDash.ph. This hyperlocal online shopping service lets you order anything from participating Robinsons Malls in one go and have them picked up or delivered straight to your doorstep.

You can avail of the on-demand service if you’re within an 8-kilometer radius from Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Ilocos, or Robinsons Place Antipolo. Robinsons Place Manila has recently joined the lineup, which comes right in time for MallDash’s first anniversary this June 2022.

MallDash comes in handy for folks who need to shop but don’t have the luxury of time to personally buy items from multiple stores. Imagine getting everything you need from over 297 stores—that includes food, groceries, medicine, clothes, accessories, and shoes, among others—with just a few clicks! You can get your purchases in just one hour or on your preferred schedule.

Using MallDash is simple. First, go to MallDash.ph and input your address and your chosen mall. From there, select your items—these could be from the supermarket, participating stores, and restaurants—and add your picks to cart. You can also type on the search bar or upload a photo of your shopping list for the Pabili option if the shop isn’t listed on the site. When you’re done, hit the checkout button, enter your name and contact details, and choose your preferred shipping method, schedule, and payment option.

A Dasher will get in touch with you to confirm your orders. From there, your Dasher will head over to the store/s to buy your items and proceed to the fulfillment center for checking and billing. Once your order arrives, you can pay either with cash or GCash.

Aside from the convenience of shopping from multiple stores in one transaction, it’s also cost-efficient because there are no extra fees and you can get your items at mall prices! Plus, you automatically get a free All-in-1 fee when your order is worth P1,500 or beyond.
Before the year ends, MallDash shoppers will be able to use more online payment channels and enjoy its mobile application for an even more convenient shopping experience.

Robinsons Malls continues to adapt to the needs of customers by providing safe, convenient, and enjoyable amenities and services in any of their malls—and with Mall Dash, this commitment extends beyond their malls’ premises. Check out MallDash now and experience this innovative shopping solution for yourself!
For more information and upcoming promos, visit www.malldash.ph or follow MallDash PH on Facebook and @malldashph on Instagram.
